title: Scan your artifacts
intro: Choose a recording of your inventory to review its artifacts and export them to Genshin Optimizer.
formats: MP4, WebM, MKV · English PC inventory · 4★ and 5★
privacy: Video processing stays on this device.
empty: No supported artifact cards found. Check the game language and recording layout.
decode: This browser could not decode the video track. Try a browser with this codec or export the recording as H.264 MP4.
canvas: Canvas 2D is unavailable in this browser.
track: The recording has no readable video track.
compare: Compare the highlighted fields with the recorded panel.
invalid: Check this value against the recording.
invalidGroup: Check the number of stats and their rolls for this level and rarity.
invalidStat: Choose a stat different from the main stat and other substats.
invalidRoll: Enter a valid roll value for this rarity.
seek: The browser could not seek in this recording. Try a finalized copy with a duration and seek index.
container: The recording could not be repackaged. Check that the file is complete.
codec: The video codec or its configuration cannot be repackaged. Try H.264 MP4.
preparing: Preparing a seekable video on this device
customNamesHint: Enter the names shown on equipped artifacts. Saved on this device for your next scan.
manekinOwner: Equipped by the Manekin. GOOD has no owner key for the Manekin. Choose Unequipped to export without an owner, or exclude this card.
